name: k3s Kubernetes
author: Rancher / CNCF
description: Lightweight certified Kubernetes (k3s) optimized for ARM64. Installs a fully functional single-node control-plane and worker.
notes: Once installation completes, switch to the Terminal tab and run "kubectl get nodes" or "kubectl get pods -A" to monitor your cluster. Kubeconfig is saved at /etc/rancher/k3s/k3s.yaml.

name: Portainer CE
author: Portainer.io
description: Powerful web-based management UI for Docker containers, images, volumes, and networks.
notes: After deployment, open http://localhost:9000 in your browser to create your admin account and manage containers visually.

name: VS Code Server
author: Coder
description: Full Visual Studio Code IDE running inside your browser with extensions, integrated terminal, and file explorer.
notes: Access your IDE at http://localhost:8443 in your browser. Default password is "linxr".

name: Node.js 20 LTS
author: Node.js Foundation
description: Node.js 20 LTS JavaScript and TypeScript runtime environment with npm package manager.
notes: Exec into the container or connect via Terminal to run Node applications, scripts, or build tools.

name: Python 3.11 Runtime
author: Python Software Foundation
description: Python 3 runtime pre-configured with pip for scripts, web backends, and data science utilities.

name: Ollama LLM Engine
author: Ollama / Alpine
description: Run local open-source Large Language Models (Llama 3, Phi-3, Mistral, Gemma) directly on ARM64.
notes: Lightweight build (~72 MB): CPU-optimized Alpine Ollama engine that downloads in seconds and saves disk space. API listens on port 11434. Pull small models like "ollama pull smollm:135m" to run on mobile.

name: Nginx Web Server
author: Nginx Inc.
description: High-performance HTTP server, reverse proxy, and static file server with minimal memory footprint.
notes: Web server is live at http://localhost:8088. Access directly from Chrome on your phone.

name: PostgreSQL 16
author: PostgreSQL Global Development Group
description: Powerful open-source object-relational database system with full ACID compliance and JSON support.
notes: Connect with: host=localhost, port=5432, user=postgres, password=linxr, db=linxr.

name: Redis In-Memory Store
author: Redis Ltd.
description: Ultra-fast in-memory key-value database, cache, message broker, and streaming engine.
notes: Redis CLI is ready at localhost:6379 without authentication.

name: Eclipse Mosquitto MQTT
author: Eclipse Foundation
description: Lightweight MQTT message broker for IoT device telemetry, home automation, and sensor networks.

name: C/C++ Build Essentials
author: Alpine Linux
description: Installs gcc, g++, make, musl-dev, git, and cmake inside Alpine for compiling native C/C++ projects.
script: apk update && apk add --no-cache build-base cmake git linux-headers
notes: Once installed, use gcc/g++ and make in the Terminal tab to build native libraries and binaries.

name: Go Programming Language
author: Google / Go Authors
description: Installs the Go compiler and toolchain inside Alpine Linux for building microservices and tools.
notes: Verify installation in the Terminal tab using "go version".

name: Rust Toolchain & Cargo
author: Rust Foundation
description: Installs the official Rust compiler (rustc) and Cargo package manager for high-performance systems development.
script: apk update && apk add --no-cache rust cargo
notes: Verify installation using "rustc --version" and "cargo --version" in the Terminal tab.

name: Grafana Dashboards
author: Grafana Labs
description: Operational dashboards for monitoring metrics, traces, and system health.
notes: Access the dashboard at http://localhost:3000 in your browser. Default login is admin / admin.
